recreation_brief: 1. Slide setup: create a blank 16:9 slide; set the slide background to solid white #FFFFFF (this is the outer margin color above, left, and right of the frame). 2. Red border frame: draw one rectangle spanning x=5% to 95% of slide width and y=7% to 95% of slide height; fill it #EBEBEB (light gray) and apply a thin red #C00000 outline of ~1.5pt (source estimate: 1-2px); send this rectangle to the back. 3. Title: insert one text box horizontally centered at ~50% width with its vertical center at ~52% height (source range: 50-55%); type exactly 'Transformer Decoder'; set the font to a bold sans-serif (Arial Bold), size ~44pt (source range: 40-48pt), color #C00000, center-aligned; this is the largest element on the slide. 4. Slide-number badge: draw one circle (oval with equal width and height) ~0.6in in diameter, centered at ~91% width and ~13% height, inside the red border in the top-right corner; fill #FFFF66, outline #6666CC at ~1.5pt; add centered text '50' inside it in Arial regular ~12pt, color #000000. 5. Light-gray band below the frame: draw one rectangle spanning the full slide width from y=95% to y=100%; fill #F5F5F5, no outline (this reproduces the 'very light gray below the border' outer margin). 6. Bottom black strip — CONDITIONAL ARTIFACT (include only for pixel-exact reproduction of the captured video frame; the source marks it as likely video player chrome, so omit it for a clean slide recreation): draw one rectangle spanning x=4% to 96% of slide width and y=96% to 100% of slide height, fill #000000, no outline, layered on top of the #F5F5F5 band from step 5. 7. Pen cursor icon — CONDITIONAL ARTIFACT (include only for pixel-exact frame reproduction; the source marks it as a likely screen-recording cursor, not slide content): insert one small pen-nib/stylus icon ~0.3in tall, centered at ~54% width and ~76% height, rotated ~45 degrees to point up-left, colored #888888 with a #333333 outline. 8. Final check: the slide contains exactly 3 content elements (red frame from step 2, title from step 3, badge from step 4) plus at most the 2 conditional artifacts from steps 6-7; no bullets, no images, no charts, no subtitle; all remaining space inside the frame stays empty #EBEBEB.
